Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 6434- 1971 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

BOW, HARE LIP TRACTION 

(DENIS BROWNE'S PATTERN) 



( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 



1. Scope — Dimensional and otiier requirements for hare lip traction bow, Denis Browne's modifica- 
tion of Logan's bow, used in plastic surgery. 

2« Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

FIG. I HARE LIP TRACTION BOW (OENIS BROWNE'S PATTERN) 

3. Material — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 22Cr13 of Schedule V of 15:1570-1961 
'Schedules for wrought steels for general engineering purposes'. 

4* Worknnanship and Finish 

4.1 The surfaces of bows shall be finished smooth and shall be free from cracks, pits, seams, burrs 
and other surface flaws. 

4*2 The edges shall be even and rounded and nowhere sharp. The hooks shall be sharp pointed. 

4.3 The hooks shall be securely screwed In and burred over. 

4.4 The slots shall be uniformly cut and the edges of the slot shall not be sharp. 



Adopted 16 August 1971 



June 1972. ISI 



Gr 1 



INDIAN STANDARDS INSTITUTION

IS: 6434 -1971 

4.5 The bows shall be passivated and polished bright. 

5. Heat Treatment — The bows shall be hardened and tempered to a hardness of 420 to 470 HV, 

6. Tests 

6.1 Flexibility Test— Press each bow in such a way that the free ends touch each other. Keep the 
ends in this pressed condition for 2 minutes. This shall be done three times. At the end of this 
test the bow shall not have acquired a new permanent set. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance Tesf — Scrub the sample with soap and warm water, rinse in hot water and 
then dip in 95 percent ethyl Blcohol. Dry the sample. Immerse in copper sulphate solution at room 
temperature for 6 minutes and wash off with fresh water or wet cotton wool. 

Make up the copper sulphate solution as follows: 

Copper sulphate (CUSO4.5H2O) 4*0 g 

Sulphuric acid (H2SO4) (sp gr 1'84) lO'O g 

Distilled water [ see IS : 1070-1960 Specification 900 ml 

for water, distilled quality {revised)"^ 

No red stains or spots on the sample shall be allowed but dulling of the polished surface may 
be permitted. 

7. Marking — Mark with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; 

b) Size of bow, that is, small or large; and 

c) Words 'Stainless Steel'. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking— Details available from the Indian Standards Institution* 

8. Packing —Wrap in moisture-proof paper or pack In polyethylene bags, avoiding contact with one 
another. The hooks shall be suitably protected. The packing may also be done as agreed to between 
the purchaser and the supplier.
